name: Maag Taranau
description: Legendary treasure vault at the center of Thunder Junction.

timeline.summary: Jace, with Vraska and disguised as Ashiok, uses Oko to assemble a team to break into Maag Taranau, wakes the child in stasis and leaves with it.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska left the other members of the team and disappeared with the child

citation.text: "Coin Empire", section "Heist of Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko announces the crew will rob Maag Taranau, a vault Annie thought a myth.
timeline.quote: "We're going to rob Maag Taranau," he said at last.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ral says he wants the vault's power sealed away and proposes taking back the key and locking the treasure on another plane.
timeline.quote: We get the key back, find the treasure inside the vault, and lock it away on another plane

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko's reunited crew enters Maag Taranau, with the silent Annie leading them through traps.
timeline.quote: Annie's left iris glowed a vivid orange as she approached the outer entrance.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Umezawa explains the dual-lever trap, and Tinybones is guided across the light grid with a dragonfly device.
timeline.quote: Annie did a few practice turns in the air before sending the dragonfly to the edge of the platform.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tinybones and Umezawa pull the levers together and disarm the light grid.
timeline.quote: They pulled the levers in unison.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaervek works on breaking the door's ward.
timeline.quote: Orange flames wove around his fingers, prodding and testing the protection spell.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul and the Hellspurs arrive, and Rakdos tackles him.
timeline.quote: Rakdos smashed into his side and clobbered him to the ground.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
timeline.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The ward breaks and Oko and Vraska descend, leaving the crew behind.
timeline.quote: He turned for the door without remorse, disappearing down the stairs with Vraska close behind.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan ropes Oko with a golden vine and Ral Zarek appears, confronting Vraska.
timeline.quote: A golden vine shot toward Oko's wrist, wrapping itself around his hand like a lasso.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Ral the only way to fix what she has done is getting what is inside the vault.
timeline.quote: "The only way to fix what I've done is by getting what's inside the vault."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan tells Oko he is his son, not crew, and Oko slams him to the ground with thorned vines after a race for the medallion.
timeline.quote: Oko barely flicked a finger, and the vines slammed Kellan against the ground with brute force.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie shoots Oko, purposely missing, and Kellan uses his fae magic as Ashiok's nightmares overwhelm them.
timeline.quote: Shadows moved across the floor, wrapping around not only Kellan but Annie and Ral, too.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko uses the key to open the vault door and enters the treasure vault.
timeline.quote: With the back of his hand, Oko wiped the blood from his chin, and stepped into the treasure vault.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's illusion drops, revealing Jace Beleren, who puts Annie to sleep.
timeline.quote: The darkness evaporated, and beneath Ashiok's hooded cloak was Jace Beleren.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace shatters the pod and takes the sleeping infant from the vault.
timeline.quote: Jace scooped up the child in his arms, cradling it to his chest.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies Oko, who planeswalks away before the stone reaches his head.
timeline.quote: "Your services are no longer required,"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes to find Vraska, Jace and the child gone and the vault collapsing, and rescues Annie.
timeline.quote: By the time he reached her side, Vraska, the man, and the child had vanished without a trace.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Rocks seal Akul inside, and the vault shoots into the clouds and vanishes.
timeline.quote: the vault shot toward the clouds and vanished from sight.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul is defeated by Rakdos at the vault; Oko opens it for Jace, who takes treasure and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: with Akul being defeated by Rakdos

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan mind-controls Akul into the vault, which rockets into the sky with him inside.
timeline.quote: ordering him to walk into the vault and never leave.

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew enters the vault; Annie finds the security grid and Akul and the Hellspurs arrive.
timeline.quote: Annie used her enhanced eyesight to search for traps

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok, revealed as Jace Beleren in disguise, incapacitates Kellan, Annie and Ral Zarek.
timeline.quote: arrived and incapacitated Kellan, Annie, and Ral

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the vault collapses, Kellan controls Akul's mind, sending him into the vault so he and Annie escape.
timeline.quote: Kellan used his magic to control Akul's mind, sending the dragon into the collapsing vault

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Thunder Junction, Oko recruits Kaervek for a heist on Maag Taranau; he is imprisoned by the Sterling Company and broken out by Eriette and Annie Flash.
timeline.quote: Eriette and Annie Flash broke them out

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Tarnation, Kaervek disables the wards on the vault; it opens and benefactor Jace takes an infant creature and vanishes with Vraska as the vault collapses.
timeline.quote: the heist's benefactor revealed himself to be Jace Beleren

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok paralyzes Kellan; the one who takes the treasure is revealed to be Jace in disguise and Oko planeswalks away from Vraska.
timeline.quote: revealing themself to be Jace Beleren in disguise

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan fully accepts his fae heritage and mind-controls Akul into releasing Annie and entering the vault forever.
timeline.quote: ordering him to release Annie, go into the vault, and never come out

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok paralyzes Kellan and Oko opens the vault, but Ashiok is revealed to be Jace in disguise; Oko planeswalks away from Vraska's gaze.
timeline.quote: Oko was only just able to planeswalk away before being petrified by Vraska's gaze.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko recruits Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau on Thunder Junction; Rakdos knocks away Ral Zarek and defeats Akul.
timeline.quote: Oko recruited Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok is revealed to be Jace Beleren, who planeswalks away without paying the gang.
timeline.quote: they revealed themself to be Jace Beleren under an illusion and planeswalked away without paying the gang

citation.text: "Satoru Umezawa", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Sol Ring is scattered across Thunder Junction when Maag Taranau is opened.
timeline.quote: A Sol Ring was scattered across the plane when Maag Taranau was opened.

citation.text: "Sol Ring", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Before the Omenpaths opened, Thunder Junction was unspoiled and uninhabited.
timeline.quote: Before the Omenpaths opened, Thunder Junction was an unspoiled, uninhabited plane.

citation.text: "Thunder Junction", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 4554 AR Tezzeret sends Jace to Thunder Junction to investigate Maag Taranau; Jace senses a slumbering childlike mind but cannot get in.
timeline.quote: Jace detected a slumbering, childlike mind deep within the vault, but could not get in.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko approaches the pod in Maag Taranau and notices a shape moving behind the glass.
timeline.quote: When the planeswalker Oko approached the pod, he noticed a shape moving behind the glass

citation.text: "Loot", section "Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, disguised as Ashiok, shatters the pod and frees Loot, then disappears with Loot and Vraska.
timeline.quote: He pressed both hands to the glass, and the pod shattered.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Fomori create Maag Taranau.
timeline.quote: Maag Taranau was created by the Fomori

citation.text: "Maag Taranau", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko opens the vault and Jace takes the infant and planeswalks, triggering a trap that sends the vault into space with Akul sealed inside.
timeline.quote: with Akul sealed inside

citation.text: "Maag Taranau", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The gang opens the vault; Jace takes Loot and triggers a collapse; the team escapes.
timeline.quote: With Kellan's backup, the team made it out safely.

citation.text: "Eriette", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Hellspurs build Tarnation to guard Maag Taranau, the legendary treasure vault.
timeline.quote: They built the town of Tarnation to guard it.

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the vault Oko opens it for Jace, who takes treasure and planeswalks away; Rakdos defeats Akul and Kellan mind controls him.
timeline.quote: Akul, for his part, was defeated by Rakdos in single combat

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals himself as Jace and shatters Loot's stasis pod; Vraska fails to petrify Oko.
timeline.quote: “Ashiok” revealed himself as Jace, who shattered Loot’s stasis pod

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The vault launches into the sky with Akul trapped inside, then falls back; Jace and Vraska planeswalk away with Loot.
timeline.quote: The vault launched into the sky with Akul trapped inside before later falling back to the surface.

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko recruits Tinybones for a heist on Maag Taranau; Tinybones travels to Thunder Junction through an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Tinybones traveled through an Omenpath to the plane and joined the crew.

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tinybones helps navigate the vault's traps and escapes after Akul assaults them.
timeline.quote: Tinybones helped navigate the maze of traps within the vault of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: The vault floats above the city of Tarnation.
relations.quote: So—the vault floats above the city.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

relations.quote: At some point, Loot was sealed in suspended animation inside Maag Taranau .

citation.text: "Loot", section "Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Maag Taranau was created by the Fomori

citation.text: "Maag Taranau", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A legendary vault, the only structure on Thunder Junction said to predate the Omenpaths, believed to hold raw power.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

pages_say.description: A jagged floating rock above Tarnation that is the vault.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

pages_say.description: The vault whose power Oko, Ral and others seek.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

pages_say.description: A floating vault above Tarnation with traps, a warded door and a treasure chamber containing a child; it flies into the clouds after being opened.

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.
